title: Chibayiro Chinogamuchirwa Netsitsi
intro: Vhara maziso ako wofungidzira mupata mukuru, wakanyarara uko kutenda kunoedzwa kusvika pamugumo. Wava kuda kusangana nemunhu ane kuzviisa pasi kwakadzikama achitarisana nemurairo usingafungidzike kwakachinja nguva yekuedzwa kuita chiratidzo chisingaperi chekuteerera netsitsi dzaMwari.
clues: Ndinorangarirwa muQuran pakati peavo vakatsungirira nemoyo murefu.
Ndakanga ndiri pakati pechiratidzo chaiedza kuzviisa pasi pemurairo waAllah.
Pandakaudzwa nezvechiratidzo, ndakati ndiite sezvandakarairwa uye muchandiwana ndiri pakati pevarwere.
Ndakanga ndaradzikwa pasi kuti ndipiwe chibayiro, asi Allah akataura kuti chiono chazadzikiswa.
Mwari vakandidzikinura nechibayiro chikuru, vachindisiyira rukudzo pakati pezvizvarwa zvinotevera.
Ndini Ismail, uyo pamwe chete naIbrahim vakasimudza nheyo dzeImba Tsvene, ndinotaurwa pamwe chete naIdris naDhul-Kifl pakati pevakarurama.

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
